notes: fiscalYear is the calendar year of the 31 January year-end: Inditex "FY2024" = fiscalYear 2025.
capex = payments for property, plant and equipment only (intangibles excluded), every year.
dilutedEPS is null for 2008-2013: those reports print EPS only in euro cents on the pre-2014-split share basis; 2014 on is in euros, split-adjusted (2014 from the 2015 report).
Latest published figures are used (next report prior-year column where available).
